summary_1line: Yudhishthira prepares for the Ashvamedha sacrifice under Vyasa’s guidance, selecting a sacred horse and appointing Arjuna to guard it during its roaming.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, bow in hand, stands beside the consecrated horse as it is released to wander across the earth under the Ashvamedha rite.
Vyasa instructs Yudhishthira in the royal court while priests prepare golden ritual implements for the coming sacrifice.
The sacred horse, adorned with ornaments, is ceremonially loosened to roam free as warriors and Brahmanas watch.
